subject: basketball
doc: Combine gates with computed statistics (Beta(1+makes, 1+misses) posterior; a gate passes when P(true rate >= threshold) >= the gate confidence (0.9 for gates of 20 attempts, 0.8 for longer ones) at n_min attempts or more, checked after every cold set), the 95% margin of a make rate at 50/100/200 attempts (why one short test day is never enough), a miss-pattern fix map, decision-clip set specs and equipment/access swaps. Counts are learner-confirmed; camera counts are estimates the learner can correct.

combine_gates.test: lay-ups at a low ring, right hand, over 2 sessions
lay-ups at a low ring, left hand, over 2 sessions
one-hand form shots from 1 m, age ring, 2 sessions
lay-ups off a dribble, right hand
lay-ups off a dribble, left hand
free throws at the age line and ring, routine every shot, 3 sessions
catch-and-shoot mid-range per zone (5 spots), 3 sessions
combine_gates.note: threshold normed by age band after 200 learners [R]

baselines.test: 10 form shots from the lesson spot
30 s stationary dribble count, each hand
baselines.use: weak/strong ratio for the weak_hand lever

miss_pattern_map.fix_drill: legs-to-arc: dip and push the floor away, then a higher arc toward the back half of the rim
miss_pattern_map.cue: push the floor away; send it up and over the front of the rim

miss_pattern_map.fix_drill: soft-touch form shots close in, higher arc, hold the follow-through
miss_pattern_map.cue: high arc, soft drop through the middle

miss_pattern_map.fix_drill: line shooting: shoot along a floor line toward the rim, one hand
miss_pattern_map.cue: send the ball straight up the line to the middle of the rim

miss_pattern_map.fix_drill: shoot over a raised target (a held pad or a partner hand) at short range
miss_pattern_map.cue: over the hand, down into the rim

decision_clip_sets.format: top-down SVG court, pause at decision, 3 options (pass, shoot, dribble)
top-down SVG, 3-4 options (open teammate, cut, fill, hold)
first-person scenes as in Rosch, Schultz & Honer 2021: 4 passing options (right/left, inside/outside), each scene twice in random blocks, accuracy primary, response time secondary
first-person or broadcast-angle SVG; options include reject/use the screen, pass to roller/popper, pull-up
mixed: transition, zone recognition, late-clock choices

access_swaps.swap: form shooting up a wall line or into a laundry basket; finishing footwork without the ball; objectives needing a hoop wait in the queue and are flagged
wall passes, rebound-return net or self-toss catch-and-shoot; ghost defence for reads
stationary handling with a soft ball, tape targets, imagery scripts
the session card keeps warm-up + the one cold set + one game-like drill; no objective is removed
